name: Workout
tagline: Push/Pull/Legs gym planner with exercise demos and treadmill interval timers. Works offline.
description: Workout is an evidence-based Push/Pull/Legs program for the gym. Pick a split and get one of six variations, each with sets, reps, RIR and rest times. Tap an exercise to see an animated demo with step-by-step instructions in English or Hindi. Start the session clock, and when you stop, export the workout to your calendar with a summary image you can keep or share. A run/walk finisher and a 20 minute interval walk timer show the treadmill speed and incline for every segment and beep before each change. There is also a full body stretching routine. Everything runs on your phone, with no account, no ads and no tracking.
